test_cases.name: Quotas in config
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect TPM and RPM capacity limits for each Foundry model
test_cases.expected_result: Valid non-zero TPM and RPM limits recorded for all 5 deployments
test_cases.evidence: Config records TPM and RPM quotas for all 5 models: {'gpt-5.6-luna': {'tpm': 150000, 'rpm': 1000}, 'gpt-5.6-terra': {'tpm': 100000, 'rpm': 800}, 'gpt-5.6-sol': {'tpm': 80000, 'rpm': 600}, 'gpt-4.1-mini': {'tpm': 200000, 'rpm': 1500}, 'DeepSeek-V3.2': {'tpm': 100000, 'rpm': 800}}

test_cases.name: Config matches portal quota
test_cases.input_setup: Compare config capacity numbers against Azure portal deployment quotas
test_cases.expected_result: Divergence between config and portal is <= 5%
test_cases.evidence: Config quota aligns perfectly with portal provisioned capacity (0.0% divergence <= 5%)

test_cases.name: Quota exhaustion throttling
test_cases.input_setup: Simulate load exceeding 95% of provisioned TPM capacity
test_cases.expected_result: Triggers 429 response accompanied by Retry-After header
test_cases.evidence: Threshold trigger at 95% TPM emitted HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 3

test_cases.name: Deployment name mapping in registry
test_cases.input_setup: Parse model registry for all 5 deployment mappings
test_cases.expected_result: Deployment names exactly match Azure target deployments
test_cases.evidence: All 5 deployments mapped in model registry matching Azure deployment IDs

test_cases.name: Hot-reload configuration updates
test_cases.input_setup: Update model deployment name environment variable dynamically at runtime
test_cases.expected_result: New deployment name reflected immediately without service restart
test_cases.evidence: Hot-reload dynamic configuration update verified: custom-luna-v2
